jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer– Cortex AI Apps
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.



We are hiring a Intermediate Software Engineer  for  our Cortex AI Applications team. This team builds the AI/ML-powered user experiences that enable enterprises to converse with their structured data and extract insights in unprecedented ways — spanning the full product lifecycle from conception through deployment. In this role, you will build scalable, responsive, and intuitive user interfaces at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise UX.




AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER  AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Contribute to the technical execution and delivery of user-facing frontend features, taking ideas from design concepts to production-ready deployments.

 - Write clean, performant, and maintainable TypeScript/React code while adhering to engineering best practices.

 - Actively participate in frontend architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews to ensure code quality and system scalability.

 - Collaborate closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to convert user requirements into detailed technical tasks and robust UI components.

 - Monitor, maintain, and optimize the frontend platform’s responsiveness, availability, and user experience.

 - Partner with backend and cross-functional teams to integrate APIs and support backend services that power AI inference and data retrieval.

 - Use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools) as an integral component of your day-to-day software development workflow.




OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER  WILL HAVE:

 - 3+ years of professional experience designing and building production web applications.

 - Actively use AI coding assistants in daily engineering workflows

 - Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and the modern React ecosystem.

 - Solid understanding of core computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, UI design patterns, and state management.

 - Proven ability to turn design mocks and product specs into production-quality code.

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

 - BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Experience building or shipping LLM-powered applications or conversational user interfaces.

 - Familiarity with major cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Prior exposure to data analytics, BI tools, or data visualization frameworks.

 - Basic understanding of backend services, REST/GraphQL APIs, or systems that serve AI/ML models.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

We are hiring a Product Engineer  for our Mobile Team. This team owns Snowflake's most visible AI products — Snowflake CoWork, our agentic AI workspace for enterprise knowledge workers, and Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), our AI coding agent. In this role, you will build the mobile experiences that bring agentic AI to users wherever they work, spanning the full product lifecycle from conception through deployment.




AS AN ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Build and ship polished, production-quality mobile features for Snowflake's agentic AI products, taking ideas from design concepts through App Store / Play Store releases.

 - Write clean, performant, and maintainable TypeScript and React Native code while adhering to engineering best practices.

 - Actively participate in mobile and frontend architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews to ensure code quality and system scalability.

 - Collaborate closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to convert user requirements into detailed technical tasks and robust mobile UI components.

 - Partner with backend and cross-functional teams to integrate APIs and support backend services that power AI inference and data retrieval.

 - Contribute to the web frontend where needed — this team works across mobile, web, and the broader agentic ecosystem.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - SnowConvert AI
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago by building the AI Data Cloud—delivering industry-leading performance and price at scale across data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML workloads. Every day, new customers begin their journey to Snowflake, but migrating existing data and applications from legacy platforms remains a complex, high-effort challenge. Customers must adapt their entire ecosystem—data, database code, ETL pipelines, and consuming applications—to fully realize Snowflake’s value. The Migrations organization serves as the catalyst for this modernization, building solutions that enable customers and partners to migrate efficiently and with less risk. Within this charter, the SnowConvert AI team delivers an AI-driven migration product that moves data-centric applications to Snowflake an order of magnitude faster than industry norms. SnowConvert goes beyond schema and SQL translation, seamlessly migrating data, code, ETL pipelines, and BI tools by combining AI-based conversion with rigorous execution-level validation, ensuring that migrated systems are not only syntactically correct, but semantically equivalent to their source and production-ready on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - The team develops fundamental code conversion techniques, robust data migration and validation pipelines, and automatic testing components. These capabilities are then leveraged by automated AI agents that process a complete application migration to Snowflake.

 - Develop the foundations that AI agents rely on for fast, consistent code conversion

 - This development team sits at the center of the original SnowConvert team, AI team, FDE to deliver the architecture below.

 - Careful API design is a must for an ever-changing landscape of AI capabilities.

 - Iterating with the FDE team enables quick feedback to prototypes, early products.




OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - Strong software engineering experience in Python, with a focus on performance, reliability, and distributed systems.

 - Hands-on experience building agentic AI applications, especially in domains such as computer control or code gen.

 - Track record of contributions to open-source agentic frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, etc.

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, and backend architectures.

 - High agency—ability to take ownership, navigate ambiguity, and independently push projects forward.
   




STRONGLY DESIRED:

 - Experience with GoLang for high-performance backend services.

 - Strong understanding of big data transformation, ETL, and ELT pipelines.

 - Proficiency in Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka or other data engineering tools.

 - Familiarity with streaming architectures, event-driven systems, and async processing.

 - Experience optimizing large-scale data pipelines for performance and cost efficiency.

 - Former founding engineers who have built and owned significant technical projects are highly valued.
   

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com
